messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — planning a JIT unpin for runtime 4.2 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Targeting quantized Llama3Q variants (q4_k_m). Need a concise rollback checklist + compatibility notes. Deploy-bot will kick off canary at T0. @prod-sre @ben please confirm monitoring owners.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: runtime=4.2 unpin JIT flag -> canary 09:00 PT. Canary window 30m, ramp 10% -> 100%. Trigger alerts on p50 latency + error-rate + model-quality regressions.

ben: TL;DR on compatibility: SDK client v1.16+ required (shim available in v1.15 but not recommended). If user clients on older SDKs hit new runtime, we should route them to sdk-compat proxy. Also note: tokenization changes in the model family may affect embeddings; add eval prompts.

maya: Rollback checklist (short):
- Preflight: run perf suite against runtime-4.2+q (local smoke) 
- Canary probes: synthetic prompts x50 every 60s, eval with golden set (3 prompts)
- Telemetry thresholds: p50 latency <= baseline *1.05, p95 <= baseline *1.15, error rate delta <= 0.2% absolute
- KV cache warmup: ensure cache hit rate > 60% in canary samples within 5m
- SDK compatibility: confirm header shim present; fail closed to 4.1 if mismatch
- Rollback command & owner assigned

kai: Rollback command snippet (for ops):
```
# immediate rollback to known-good runtime
deployctl rollout cancel --job $JOB_ID  # stop current rollout
deployctl set-pin --runtime runtime=4.1 --reason "rollback: jit-unpin regressed" --by release-manager
# fallback route for affected models
routectl set-weight --route model=llama3q --variant=llama3q-stable --weight=100
```
Add to runbook: if KV eviction or memory blowups show, escalate to eng-runtime.

prod-sre: Traffic ramp guidance: 10% steps every 3 minutes, hold at each step for 3 probes. Auto-abort if:
- p50 > baseline *1.08 for two consecutive holds OR
- p95 spike > baseline *1.25 OR
- error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute in any 3-minute window
Fallback routing: route by policy to dedicated capacity in us-west-2 or to model-variant with lower memory (llama3q-lite).

olivia: Release notes line (short): "Runtime 4.2: JIT-unpin enabled for improved memory stability on quantized models. SDK clients must be v1.16+. Canary 09:00 PT. See runbook for rollback steps." Who will own the canary watch? :eyes:

ben: I can own initial 30m canary watch, escalate to prod-sre at T0+30m. I'll post metrics dashboard link in #eng-monitoring.

maya: Added three golden prompts to the perf-evals suite (link: https://internal.redwood/perf-evals/llama3q). Please avoid adding heavy private PII prompts to canary.

release-manager: Noted. I'll publish release notes and tag change window. Small ask: keep rollback commands in the runbook exact (no hand edits) — I've updated the runbook section and pinned it: https://runbook.redwood/release/rollback-jit-unpin (internal).

kai: One more pro-tip: when you run `deployctl set-pin` include `--force-evict-kvcache` if you want clean state on rollback; otherwise some sessions might keep stale caches. Use with caution.

olivia: Perfect. Action items: ben = canary watch owner, release-manager = publish notes + runbook link, maya = perf-eval updates, kai = ops rollback snippet in runbook, prod-sre = monitoring thresholds confirmed. If anyone sees anything off during canary ping in-thread + @oncall.

ben: Will post dashboard + alert watches 15m before start.

prod-sre: I'll add auto-abort rules to deploy-bot for the thresholds above.

olivia: Thanks team — we'll proceed with the planned window. :thumbsup:
